arguments.prompt: Create a NEW genuine native pixel-art four-frame melee SUPER strip of Ranger from the original Quake (1996), NOT Quake Champions, using the attached atlas only to keep his selected appearance and axe design. Adult muscular brown/olive armoured marine, square human head with short dark-brown crew cut, bare muscular upper arms, green sleeveless chest armour with dark straps, brown camouflage trousers, brown knee pads and boots, same body proportions and pixel art as the reference. Exactly FOUR DISTINCT complete full-body drawings, ONE horizontal row with FOUR generously separated columns, side/three-quarter side view facing RIGHT in ALL FOUR poses. Exactly ONE complete small physical Quake starting axe, short wooden handle and dark red-brown single-bladed metal head exactly as in the reference, clearly visible and HELD in the hands in EVERY pose. Pose1 compact braced axe ready; pose2 draw the held axe back but keep axe head and handle visible beside the body; pose3 controlled forward melee axe cut toward empty screen-right, face/torso still visible in side view, the COMPLETE axe head and haft prominently visible in front and held firmly; pose4 recover to axe guard with axe fully visible. Third pose is contact; NEVER turn his back to camera, NEVER hide the axe behind the torso, NEVER throw/release/drop the axe, NEVER show empty hands. No orb, magic, energy, projectile, flash, painted swing trail, futuristic rifle, Quake Champions extras, opponent, injury, scenery, floor, shadow, grid, labels or text. Transparent RGBA background and ample transparent margins around all four complete figures, feet, armour and axe tips. Keep armour and axe identical across the four genuine independently drawn body/arm/leg poses. No duplicate or mirrored drawings. This is a generated adaptation of Quake1996, not official extracted frames.
